KKD_CITY.desc: The old spice port in one easy day: Tali temple and Kuttichira's wooden mosques, Mananchira and SM Street's halwa, Kappad where Vasco da Gama landed, and a sunset on Kozhikode beach.
KKD_CITY.itin:
9:00 AM — Pickup: Kozhikode railway station · KSRTC Mavoor Road bus station · Calicut Airport (on request) (Airport pickup from 7:45 AM)
9:30 AM — Tali temple & Kuttichira: The old Zamorin-era Shiva temple, then Kuttichira's tank and the centuries-old wooden Mishkal mosque. (Modest dress · temple rules apply)
11:15 AM — Mananchira & SM Street: The town square and its pond, then Mittai Theruvu for halwa and banana chips. Lunch here, own expense. (Street is walk-only)
2:30 PM — Kappad Beach: The quiet beach and memorial stone where Vasco da Gama landed in 1498. (No swimming in rough sea)
4:45 PM — Kozhikode Beach & lighthouse: The promenade, old sea piers and lighthouse as the sun goes down. Street snacks own expense.
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Kozhikode station, KSRTC bus station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop in the city
KKD_CITY.gtk:
🛕 Temple & mosque: Tali temple follows traditional dress and entry rules; some areas may be open to Hindus only. At Kuttichira, view the mosques respectfully from outside unless invited in; we avoid Friday prayer time.
👗 What to wear: Shoulders and knees covered for the temple and Kuttichira. Men may be asked to remove shirts inside the temple.
🚶 Walking: SM Street is a walking street — about 2–3 km of easy walking through the day. Comfortable footwear; the old lanes can be crowded.
✈️ Flying in?: We can pick you up at Calicut Airport in the morning — it adds about an hour. Or end your day at the airport for a late flight: ask us.
KKD_CITY.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KKD_CITY.exc: Lunch and snacks; Any entry or camera fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KKD_CITY.carry: Comfortable walking shoes; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for halwa & street food

KKD_BEYPORE.desc: Kozhikode's sea-faring south: shipwrights building wooden urus by hand, a breakwater walk into the Arabian Sea at Beypore, and migratory birds on the Kadalundi estuary.
KKD_BEYPORE.itin:
8:30 AM — Pickup: Kozhikode railway station · KSRTC Mavoor Road bus station · Calicut Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
9:15 AM — Beypore uru yard: Watch shipwrights shape giant wooden dhows the way they have for centuries. (Working yard · ask before photos)
10:45 AM — Beypore beach & pulimuttu: A walk along the long breakwater out into the sea, with the Chaliyar river mouth beside you. (Closed in rough sea)
12:45 PM — Lunch · Feroke: A Malabar lunch break on the way south, own expense.
2:15 PM — Kadalundi bird sanctuary: Mangroves and mudflats where the river meets the sea; terns, herons and waders. Country-boat ride if offered, paid direct. (Best Nov–Apr)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Kozhikode station, KSRTC bus station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop in the city
KKD_BEYPORE.gtk:
🐦 Bird season: Migratory birds peak from November to April; the rest of the year you see resident herons, egrets and kingfishers. Low tide in the morning or late afternoon shows the most birds — we time it on the day.
🌊 Breakwater: The pulimuttu is a long stone breakwater; no climbing on the boulders and no walk in rough sea. In the monsoon and on high-wave alerts it is closed — we spend longer at the uru yard.
🚢 The uru yard: It is a working family yard, not a museum: keep clear of tools and timber. Ask before taking photos of the workers.
🛶 Boats: Kadalundi boat rides are run by local operators, paid direct; life jackets for everyone. No boats after dusk or when the river is high.
KKD_BEYPORE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KKD_BEYPORE.exc: Lunch; Boat ride and any entry fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KKD_BEYPORE.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Binoculars if you have them; Comfortable shoes; Cash for boat & snacks

KKD_KAKKAYAM.desc: Into the Malabar forest hills: the Kakkayam reservoir and its forest ghat, a boat on still green water, then the Peruvannamuzhi dam and gardens on the Kuttiady river.
KKD_KAKKAYAM.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kozhikode railway station · KSRTC Mavoor Road bus station · Calicut Airport (on request)
9:15 AM — Kakkayam dam & reservoir: Up the forest ghat past the check post to the dam, viewpoints and a boat on the reservoir if running. (Entry & boating own expense)
11:00 AM — Forest walk & viewpoint: A short guided walk near the dam towards the gorge and falls, if the forest staff allow it that day. (Seasonal · forest rules)
12:45 PM — Lunch · Koorachundu: Simple Kerala meals in the hill town, own expense.
2:30 PM — Peruvannamuzhi dam: The dam on the Kuttiady river, its garden and a boat ride on the reservoir. (Boating paid direct)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kozhikode station, KSRTC bus station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop in the city
KKD_KAKKAYAM.gtk:
🌳 Forest rules: Kakkayam lies on the edge of the Malabar Wildlife Sanctuary; the forest check post has fixed timings and may check bags. No plastic, no music, no feeding animals; stay with the group on walks.
🌧️ Rain & closures: In heavy rain the forest department or KSEB may close the dam area, walks or boating. We check the evening before; if Kakkayam is shut we spend longer at Peruvannamuzhi.
⛰️ The ghat: The last stretch to Kakkayam is a steep, narrow forest ghat with tight bends. If you get car-sick, sit in front and take your tablet before the climb.
🛶 Boating: Boats are run by the dam tourism counters, paid direct; life jackets for everyone. Boating may stop in wind or rain, or after the afternoon cut-off.
KKD_KAKKAYAM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KKD_KAKKAYAM.exc: Lunch; Entry, walk and boating fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KKD_KAKKAYAM.carry: Shoes with good grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Motion-sickness tablets; Cash for tickets

KKD_THUSHARAGIRI.desc: The 'misty peaks' of Kozhikode: a forest trail to the three Thusharagiri falls on the Chalippuzha, then the rock-ribbed cascades of Arippara near Thiruvambady.
KKD_THUSHARAGIRI.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Kozhikode railway station · KSRTC Mavoor Road bus station · Calicut Airport (on request)
9:15 AM — Thusharagiri: Erattumukku falls: The first and easiest falls, where two streams meet, via a short forest path from the gate. (Entry own expense)
10:30 AM — Upper falls trail: A guided climb towards Mazhavil Chattam and Thumbithullum Para for those who are fit. (Optional · forest guide)
1:00 PM — Lunch · Kodanchery: Simple Kerala meals in the town, own expense.
2:30 PM — Arippara Falls: Water racing over wide rock shelves near Anakkampoyil — a viewing stop. (No bathing)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Kozhikode station, KSRTC bus station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop in the city
KKD_THUSHARAGIRI.gtk:
🌧️ Season & closures: The falls are at their best from July to January; in peak monsoon the forest staff may close the trail. We check the evening before; if the falls are closed we tell you and offer a change of date.
🥾 The trail: Erattumukku is an easy walk; the upper falls need a steep, rocky climb with a forest guide. Wear shoes with grip — the rocks are slippery all year.
🚫 No bathing: Bathing and climbing on the rocks are not allowed at Thusharagiri or Arippara — currents are strong and water rises suddenly. Lives have been lost at these falls; please follow the guards.
🚯 Plastic-free: No disposable plastic inside the eco-tourism area; bags may be checked at the gate. Bring a reusable bottle; we carry the rubbish back.
KKD_THUSHARAGIRI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KKD_THUSHARAGIRI.exc: Lunch; Entry and guide fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KKD_THUSHARAGIRI.carry: Shoes with good grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Spare socks & salt (leeches); Cash for entry tickets

KKD_WAYANAD.desc: Up the nine hairpins of the Thamarassery ghat for a day in Wayanad: the view from Lakkidi, a forest lake at Pookode and India's largest earth dam at Banasura Sagar.
KKD_WAYANAD.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: Kozhikode railway station · KSRTC Mavoor Road bus station · Calicut Airport (on request) (Breakfast at Thamarassery, own expense)
8:45 AM — Thamarassery ghat & Lakkidi: Nine hairpins up to the Lakkidi viewpoint and the Chain Tree. (Photos at the viewpoint only)
9:30 AM — Pookode Lake: A freshwater lake ringed by forest. (Entry & boating own expense)
11:45 AM — Banasura Sagar Dam: India's largest earth dam, with islands in the reservoir. Lunch after, own expense. (Entry & boating own expense)
2:30 PM — Kalpetta: tea, spice & honey: Wayanad tea, pepper and honey before the drive down. (Shopping optional)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kozhikode station, KSRTC bus station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop in the city
KKD_WAYANAD.gtk:
⛰️ The ghat: About 2 hours each way via Thamarassery and the ghat — longer on weekends and holidays. We leave Wayanad by 3:00 PM so the drive down is in daylight.
🌧️ Rain & closures: Heavy-rain alerts can close the ghat, the dam or boating — we check the evening before. If the ghat is shut we call you and reschedule or refund.
🤢 Winding roads: The ghat has nine hairpins — take a motion-sickness tablet if you need one. Tell us when booking and we'll keep a front seat for you.
🗓️ Want more time?: Edakkal Caves and the treks need another day. Ask about our private Wayanad 2-day trip.
KKD_WAYANAD.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KKD_WAYANAD.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Lake, dam and boating fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KKD_WAYANAD.carry: Light jacket or raincoat; Motion sickness tablets; Walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

KKD_CCJ.desc: Flying from Calicut International at Karipur? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Kozhikode and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
KKD_CCJ.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Kozhikode city, Feroke, Ramanattukara or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~28 km via Ramanattukara: About 45 minutes to 1 hour via Meenchanda, Ramanattukara and the Kondotty road — longer at peak hours.
Drop-off — Calicut International Airport: Domestic or international departures at Karipur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KKD_CCJ.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 4 hours before an international flight and 3 hours before a domestic one. Meenchanda and Ramanattukara jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Karipur has separate domestic and international terminals on one campus. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Karipur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KKD_CCJ.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KKD_CCJ.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
KKD_CCJ.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal noted; Water for the drive

KKD_CNN.desc: Flying from Kannur International at Mattannur? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Kozhikode and drop you at the terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
KKD_CNN.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Kozhikode city, Koyilandy, Vadakara or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~105 km via Thalassery: About 2.5–3 hours on NH 66 via Koyilandy, Vadakara and the Mahe bypass, then Kuthuparamba and Mattannur.
Drop-off — Kannur International Airport: Departures kerb at Mattannur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KKD_CNN.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 6 hours before an international flight and 5 hours before a domestic one. Koyilandy, Vadakara and Thalassery can jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 At the airport: Kannur airport has one terminal building for domestic and international flights. Tell us your flight and we drop you at the right departures door.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Kannur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KKD_CNN.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KKD_CNN.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
KKD_CNN.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Web check-in done; Water for the drive

KKD_WAYANAD2.desc: Up the Thamarassery ghat to Kerala's green north: a forest lake, India's largest earth dam and Edakkal's ancient carvings — two easy days with your own vehicle and driver.
KKD_WAYANAD2.itin:
Day 1 · 7:00 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, hotel, Kozhikode station, the KSRTC stand or Calicut Airport — about 72 km over the Thamarassery ghat, roughly 2.5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · morning — Lakkidi viewpoint & Pookode Lake: The view back down the ghat, then a forest lake right on the way in. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 1 · afternoon — Banasura Sagar Dam: India's largest earth dam, with green islands in the reservoir. Overnight in Kalpetta or Vythiri. (Entry & boating own expense)
Day 2 · morning — Edakkal Caves: A short, steep climb to caves with prehistoric rock carvings. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 2 · or swap in — Soochipara Falls or Kuruva Island: A forest waterfall near Meppadi or bamboo-raft river islands — pick one. (Seasonal · we check if open)
Day 2 · ~7:00 PM — Drive home: Leave Wayanad by 3:30 PM so the ghat is done in daylight; home in Kozhikode by evening.
KKD_WAYANAD2.gtk:
🪨 Edakkal Caves: Closed on Mondays — on a Sunday start we visit on Day 1 instead. The climb is steep: not ideal for elders or small children.
🌧️ Seasonal spots: Kuruva Island closes in the monsoon and has a daily visitor cap; falls can shut after heavy rain. We check on the day and swap stops.
🏨 Your stay: You book your resort or homestay; Kalpetta and Vythiri are central. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
⛰️ The ghat: Thamarassery ghat jams on weekends and holidays. We start early and come down before dark.
KKD_WAYANAD2.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KKD_WAYANAD2.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and trek fees; Tolls and parking
KKD_WAYANAD2.carry: Walking shoes; Raincoat; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

KKD_COORG.desc: Over the Wayanad hills into Karnataka's coffee country: misty Madikeri, Abbey Falls, Dubare's elephants, the Tibetan Golden Temple and the source of the Kaveri — your own vehicle and driver.
KKD_COORG.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Coorg: From your door in Kozhikode — about 215 km via the Thamarassery ghat, Mananthavady and Kutta, roughly 7 hours. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · afternoon — Abbey Falls: A short walk down through coffee and spice estates to the falls near Madikeri. (Entry own expense · no bathing)
Day 1 · sunset — Raja's Seat: The Kodava kings' garden lookout over layers of misty hills. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 8:30 AM — Dubare Elephant Camp: Watch the camp elephants bathe and feed by the Kaveri — reached by boat. (Mornings only · paid direct)
Day 2 · noon — Golden Temple, Bylakuppe: The great Namdroling monastery in the Tibetan settlement; Tibetan lunch nearby. (Shoes off · quiet inside)
Day 3 · 7:00 AM — Talacauvery & Bhagamandala: The source of the Kaveri on Brahmagiri, then the Triveni Sangama temple. (Temple dress code)
Day 3 · noon — Drive home: About 215 km back the same way; at your door in Kozhikode by evening.
KKD_COORG.gtk:
🐘 Dubare & the seasons: Elephant activities run only in the morning; the boat crossing can stop when the river is high. Falls and hill paths are slippery in the monsoon (June–September).
🛕 Temples & monastery: Talacauvery and Bhagamandala: modest dress, footwear off, temple customs apply. Golden Temple: shoes off and quiet inside; follow the signs on photos.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Coorg is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stays: You book two nights in or near Madikeri — coffee-estate homestays are a Coorg favourite. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
KKD_COORG.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Coorg sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
KKD_COORG.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Entry, elephant camp and boat fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KKD_COORG.carry: Light jacket and raincoat; Photo ID; Comfortable walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

KKD_OOTY.desc: Through Nilambur's teak country and up the Nadukani ghat to the Nilgiris: Pykara falls, Ooty's gardens and lake, and the highest peak in the hills — your vehicle, your pace.
KKD_OOTY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Ooty: From your door in Kozhikode — about 170 km via Nilambur, the Nadukani ghat and Gudalur, roughly 6 hours with breaks. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · morning — Nilambur & the Nadukani ghat: Kerala's teak country, then a forested climb to the Tamil Nadu border. (Elephant country · no stops)
Day 1 · noon — Pykara Falls & Lake: Falls and a boat lake on the Gudalur–Ooty road, 20 km before town. (Entry & boating paid direct)
Day 1 · afternoon — Botanical Garden & Ooty Lake: Ooty's 1840s gardens, then a walk or a boat on the lake. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Doddabetta Peak & tea factory: The highest point in the Nilgiris, then a working tea factory on the way down. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 11:00 AM — Drive home: About 170 km back via Gudalur and Nilambur; at your door in Kozhikode by early evening.
KKD_OOTY.gtk:
🎫 Nilgiris e-pass: Every vehicle entering the Nilgiris needs a Tamil Nadu e-pass — we apply for it. Single-use plastic is banned: carry refillable steel bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Ooty is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🐘 Ghat roads: Nadukani and Naduvattam ghats have wild elephants — we drive in daylight and never stop in the forest. Many hairpins: carry motion sickness tablets.
🧥 Weather: Cold nights all year — bring warm clothes. Clouds often hide Doddabetta's view by late morning, so we go early.
KKD_OOTY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Ooty and Pykara sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KKD_OOTY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KKD_OOTY.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Refillable water bottle; Cash for entry fees

KKD_MYSORE.desc: Up the Thamarassery ghat, across Wayanad and through the Bandipur forest to Mysore's palace, Chamundi Hill, Brindavan and Srirangapatna — a royal road trip in your own vehicle.
KKD_MYSORE.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Mysore: From your door in Kozhikode — about 220 km via the Thamarassery ghat, Sulthan Bathery and Bandipur, roughly 7 hours. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · late morning — Muthanga & Bandipur forests: The highway runs through two wildlife reserves — watch for deer and elephants. (Forest road closed at night)
Day 1 · evening — Srirangapatna & Brindavan Gardens: Tipu Sultan's island fort, then the gardens and musical fountain below KRS dam. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · morning — Mysore Palace: The Wodeyars' palace of stained glass, mirrors and carved doors. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Chamundi Hill & the lit-up palace: The hilltop temple and city view; the palace lights up on Sunday and holiday evenings. (Illumination Sun & holidays)
Day 3 · 7:00 AM — Drive home: About 220 km back through Bandipur and Wayanad; at your door in Kozhikode by mid-afternoon.
KKD_MYSORE.gtk:
🏰 Mysore Palace: Plan Day 2 on a Sunday or public holiday for the evening illumination. Shoes are removed inside — carry socks.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Mysore is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🐘 Bandipur road: The forest stretch is closed to traffic from 9 PM to 6 AM — we cross in daylight. No stopping or feeding animals inside the forest.
🏨 Your stays: You book two nights in Mysore; near the palace is easiest. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
KKD_MYSORE.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Mysore sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
KKD_MYSORE.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Palace, garden and entry fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KKD_MYSORE.carry: Photo ID; Socks for the palace; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

KKD_BEKAL.desc: North along the Malabar coast: Thalassery's old fort, the drive-in beach, Kannur's Portuguese sea fort, the Muthappan temple, a Bekal sunset and the great fort itself — your own vehicle and driver.
KKD_BEKAL.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive north: From your door in Kozhikode — about 70 km on NH 66 via Vadakara and Mahe to Thalassery.
Day 1 · morning — Thalassery Fort & Muzhappilangad: The East India Company's old fort, then Kerala's long drive-in beach. (Check timings)
Day 1 · late morning — St Angelo Fort & Arakkal Museum: Kannur's 1505 Portuguese sea fort and the Arakkal royal palace. Lunch in Kannur. (Entry own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Muthappan Temple, then Bekal: Parassinikadavu's riverside temple, open to all faiths; then 80 km north for a Bekal sunset and overnight. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Bekal Fort: Kerala's largest fort: a giant keyhole of laterite walls over the sea. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · late morning — Valiyaparamba backwaters: Island-dotted backwaters near Nileshwar — an optional boat ride. (Boat paid direct)
Day 2 · ~5:30 PM — Drive home: About 150 km south on NH 66; at your door in Kozhikode by evening.
KKD_BEKAL.gtk:
🏰 Forts & museum: Bekal and St Angelo are protected forts with set opening hours; entry own expense. Arakkal Museum has a weekly closing day — we plan around it.
🌊 Beach safety: Swim only at lifeguard-flagged spots; no sea bathing in the monsoon (June–September). At the drive-in beach the vehicle stays on the road — you walk the sand.
🛕 Muthappan temple: Open to all; modest dress and footwear off. The temple serves tea and a simple meal to every visitor.
🏨 Your stay: You book one night near Bekal — beach resorts or town hotels. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
KKD_BEKAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Kannur & Bekal sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KKD_BEKAL.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boat fees; Tolls and parking
KKD_BEKAL.carry: Swimwear and towel; Hat and sunscreen; Clothes for the temple; Cash for entry fees

KKD_VELANKANNI.desc: A relaxed day at Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, Morning Star Church, the shore — from Kozhikode, Karur halt home.
KKD_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 4:00 AM — Pickup: Kozhikode railway station · KSRTC Mavoor Road bus station · Calicut Airport (on request) (≈555 km via Trichy)
Day 1 · evening — Velankanni Basilica: Via Palakkad and Trichy; check in, then evening prayer at the shrine. (Lodge list shared)
Day 2 · morning — Mass, Tank & museum: Mass, Our Lady's Tank, Morning Star Church and the museum. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · afternoon — Nadu Thittu chapel: Where Our Lady is said to have first appeared; candles and quiet prayer.
Day 2 · evening — Rosary & beach: Evening rosary and candle prayers, then sunset on the shore. (No swimming)
Day 3 · afternoon — Last prayers & Karur: A free morning at the shrine, then ≈225 km to a night in Karur. (Room booked by you)
Day 4 · ~3:30 PM — Drop-off: Kozhikode station, KSRTC bus station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop in the city
KKD_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Dress modestly; footwear off where asked, quiet in the queues. Masses run through the day in Tamil, English and other languages; we confirm the Malayalam Mass time.
🌊 The beach: The sea here is rough and drownings are reported — paddle only, never swim. Crowds are big: agree a meeting point and keep children close.
🏨 Your rooms: You book your rooms; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine and hotels in Karur. Driver bata and night allowances are in our price.
🛣️ Long drive days: Day 1 is a long day of about 14 hours with breaks; the way home is split in two. Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are at actual cost.
KKD_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowances; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KKD_VELANKANNI.exc: Your rooms; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KKD_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Hat or umbrella for the sun; Cash for offerings and candles
